sources.name: StraighterLine
sources.creditBasis: ACE recommendations for designated college-level courses; prep and certification-training products may be excluded.
sources.summary: Current offer. Broad self-paced course catalog, including business, general education and lab options. Confirm the exact course and receiving degree before purchasing.
sources.pace: Self-paced; completion time depends on assignments, labs and assessment readiness.
sources.priceNote: Published pricing: $99/month plus individual course charges. New-student plans advertise $699/four months or $1,499/year for 27 selected courses; lab kits are extra. Verify eligibility, renewals and checkout.
sources.assessmentNote: Courses use different mixes of Checkpoints, Capstones and exams. Secured final Benchmarks require Honorlock screen sharing and browser restrictions, without a live proctor watching. Some courses list no final; book rules vary by course.

sources.name: Sophia Learning
sources.creditBasis: ACE recommendations for designated courses; a recommendation is not automatic university credit.
sources.summary: Current offer. General education and other college-level courses through a subscription. Check developmental or noncredit exclusions and receiving-school applicability.

sources.priceNote: Published monthly price is $99 before applicable tax; longer subscriptions are available. Official pages disagree about the annual price, so verify checkout.
sources.assessmentNote: Open-book assessments without proctored exams. Identity verification may be required. Written or project Touchstones and lab activities depend on the course.

sources.name: Study.com

sources.assessmentNote: College Saver and College Saver Pro exams are open-book and unproctored. Identity verification is required before each final; finals use a desktop or laptop. Course-specific assignments still apply.

sources.name: Saylor Direct Credit

sources.summary: Current offer. Free learning with a separate credit examination. Current Saylor University branding does not by itself establish institutional-origin transfer classification.

sources.priceNote: Official FAQ lists free study/transcripts and $5 per proctored attempt. Check each credit exam remains available.
sources.assessmentNote: Pass the designated proctored Direct Credit exam; an ordinary certificate final does not produce the credit recommendation.

evidence.title: Current Direct Credit eligibility, fees and attempts

sources.name: CLEP examinations
sources.creditBasis: College Board examinations with exam-specific ACE recommendations; each institution sets scores, awards and applicability.
sources.summary: Current offer. Demonstrate existing knowledge or prepare independently across general education and business subjects.

sources.priceNote: Official current pages display a $97 exam fee. Remote proctoring adds $30; testing-center charges vary. Eligible Modern States or military funding may change net cost.
sources.assessmentNote: Proctored at a test center or remotely where eligible. Remote delivery has age, location, equipment and room requirements.

sources.name: Modern States CLEP preparation and vouchers
sources.creditBasis: Preparation and exam funding only. Actual credit comes from an accepted CLEP examination, not an extra Modern States award.

sources.assessmentNote: Current voucher criteria include a 75% quiz average and 75% final score. The subsequent CLEP examination remains proctored.

sources.name: DSST examinations
sources.creditBasis: Credit examinations with individual recommended credit amounts and levels; the receiving university decides the award.
sources.summary: Credit-by-examination options. Five exact exam-form matches are documented for Liberty online undergraduate requirements; coverage for other exams and schools remains DegreeSteps research.
sources.pace: Prepare independently and schedule an appointment; current policy includes a 30-day retest interval.
sources.priceNote: Published exam fee: $100 per distinct exam, plus testing-center administration charges. Military funding or reimbursement depends on the student’s own eligibility and program rules.
sources.assessmentNote: Test-center or remote ProProctor delivery where offered. Public Speaking includes a speech and is not available remotely.

sources.priceNote: TESU rates effective August 2026 list $54 per lower-level credit and $81 per upper-level credit. Verify the exam credit amount and current registration terms.
sources.assessmentNote: Official arrangements include online proctoring through OPS/ProctorU and an eligible approved paper-proctor route; follow the specific test description.

sources.name: Davar Academy

sources.assessmentNote: Course assessments culminate in a proctored examination; assignment requirements depend on the course.

sources.summary: Current offer with eligibility limits. Official support directs adult learners to Briar Cliff; McMurry and Oklahoma Christian options require current high-school enrollment. Confirm partner eligibility and destination acceptance.
sources.pace: Self-paced with minimum participation periods: one course requires 14 days, two 28, three 42 and four 56; maximum course window is six months.
sources.priceNote: Per-credit tuition. Official enrollment and support pages disagree ($100 versus $75 per credit); obtain the current partner checkout quote.
sources.assessmentNote: Assignments and Honorlock-proctored exams; follow the chosen university and course rules.

sources.name: ASU Universal Learner Courses
sources.creditBasis: Arizona State University coursework. A final grade of C or better plus the optional credit purchase adds the course and earned grade to an official ASU transcript. A course can only be transcripted once; the receiving college decides acceptance and degree placement.
sources.summary: University coursework with a choice to see the grade before buying credit. Admitted, degree-seeking ASU students cannot use this route; deferral, inactive-enrollment and academic-standing rules can affect eligibility.
sources.pace: On-demand courses allow one year to finish. Earliest credit eligibility is six weeks after enrollment for 3–4 credits, four weeks for 2 credits and two weeks for 1 credit; these are minimums, not completion promises. Session-based courses have fixed start dates and due dates. After completion and credit purchase, the ULC FAQ allows up to 14 business days for transcript posting.
sources.priceNote: $25 to enroll plus $400 if eligible credit is purchased ($425 per converted course). Purchase within one year of course completion; check the dashboard deadline. Sending an official ASU transcript costs $15 per copy before applicable tax or delivery extras. ULC courses are not eligible for federal financial aid.
sources.assessmentNote: Assessments vary by course. Some require Honorlock webcam and screen proctoring; use the catalog’s proctoring filter and current syllabus. Identity verification is required before starting. A non-proctored course still has its own assignments and grading schedule.
